title: Zero-Cost Research Dataset Manifest + Baseline Experiment Runner
summary: Research-only manifest, temporal dataset contract and deterministic A-F baseline runner are complete. Existing verified assets do not contain sufficient rolling team history, so no model-quality or ROI claim is made.
